name: Vina Miles
source:
"Hey! You're new here, aren't you?!"

A short, precocious, and arrogant young woman. As the self-proclaimed leader of a trio of bullies, she often stands front and center with crossed arms. Other students sometimes mistake her dominating personality as charisma.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=vina]official page[/url]]
